recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native mobile canvas incremental management game called Sidewalk Showdown: Toy Cowboy Street Syndicate. Preserve the mechanics of a service tower: visitors spawn at the bottom, move to an entry hub, get assigned to idle service rooms, wait through timers, leave, and pay currency; players spend currency to build paired rooms upward, scroll the tower, tap rooms for an upgrade modal, upgrade speed/value, and unlock a special visitor type and special room around levels 25 and 28. Rebuild the presentation as a Persona-inspired street poster world centered on a toy cowboy sheriff running a curbside block. Use high-contrast black/red/cyan/yellow panels, graffiti, toy-hat silhouettes, stars, road markings, comic impact copy, mobile-safe HUD buttons, and procedural canvas entities.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first incremental canvas management / idle-service tower game.
- objective: spend earned currency to build service rooms, route spawned visitors into idle rooms, collect payout when service timers complete, upgrade speed/value, and unlock special visitor/room behavior by room count.
- input model: tap build buttons; tap non-entry rooms to open an upgrade modal; drag/touch canvas vertically to scroll the tower; modal buttons upgrade or close.
- core loop: visitors spawn, enter the central entry, seek available rooms, occupy rooms for a timed service, leave, and pay money; money buys more rooms and upgrades.
- fail/friction state: insufficient cash blocks build/upgrade; visitor capacity caps spawning; later special visitors can become hostile if not routed to the special room.

## Protected mechanics
- Initial money, room placement cadence, two-side floor stacking, scrollable vertical camera, room count level display, build costs, upgrade cost growth, timed service payout, visitor routing states, unlock thresholds at 25 and 28, special visitor decay/attack behavior, modal pause/resume flow, and mobile tap/drag semantics are preserved.

## Remixed target
Sidewalk Showdown: Toy Cowboy Street Syndicate reframes the management tower as a Persona-inspired street poster scene. The central toy cowboy sheriff runs a curbside block; standard rooms become pop-up street stalls, visitors become sneaker kids, special visitors become shadow crew, and special rooms become Lasso Lounges that calm block pressure. The canvas, HUD, copy, colors, silhouettes, and feedback are rebuilt around graphic comic panels, graffiti signs, road stripes, toy hats, stars, and high-contrast street-night motion while preserving the incremental service loop.
